text:
release-sherpa: Heads up team 18: we're targeting a 23:30 UTC rollout for the 3.5 change window. Deploy freeze starts at 23:00 UTC for the affected slices (eu, na-west). Please confirm youre ready and call out any exempt hotfixes now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Preflight results: config-check=PASS, infra-capacity=OK, migrations-lock=SET, secrets-check=OK. Generated canary id=crn-20240219-77. Canary plan: stages=3, ramp=[0.5%,1.5%,5%], metrics=latency,p50+p95;errors=4xx+5xx;cache-hit.

lucy: ACK. Freeze noted. I'm toggling feature flags to locked for eu slice. Also I pre-warmed model cache for popular prompts.

dennis: Quick note: QA will run smoke suite T+5m and T+25m. If semantic-qa fails, we hold and run rollback checklist. Threshold: semantic F1 drop >3 points triggers manual review.

ops-lead: On-call overlap set 23:15-01:00 UTC. Paging escalation path updated. If deploy-bot issues hard-rollback we execute emergency-unpin and revert routing within 2m. Runbook snippets added to the thread.

release-sherpa: Freeze exceptions: only critical db-migrations approved. @lucy please confirm migration id list and that migrations are backward compatible. If any migration requires sweeping, we postpone.

lucy: Migrations pinned: 3.5-20240219-a (lightweight indices), 3.5-20240219-b (nullable column add). Both are backward compatible via toggles. No sweeping required.

sam-qc: Adding a short quality gate: run a 10-sample prompt set through both v3.4 and v3.5-q8 at T+5. Flag if hallucination rate increases >1.5x. I'll post results.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1709002200 (23:30 UTC). During canary: extra logs=on for 7m, cache-metrics=per-slice, model-variant=v3.5-q8, fallback=v3.4.

dennis: Rollback thresholds clarified? we had noise around 5xx spikes before.

release-sherpa: Two-stage rollback policy: soft-alert at 2.5% error-rate (auto-notify), hold-and-investigate at 4.0% (manual), hard-rollback at 6.0% sustained for 3m. For latency, p95 > 1.5x baseline sustained 5m triggers manual triage.

ops-lead: Runbook extract: ```
# Emergency rollback steps
1) deploy-bot rollback --canary crn-20240219-77 --reason "hard-threshold"
2) ./ops/unpin-slices.sh eu na-west
3) routing set-default --model v3.4
4) notify #incidents and attach dumps
```

lucy: I'm also enabling a short-lived feature-flag that makes read-only fallbacks for write-heavy endpoints if we see db contention.

sam-qc: Posting smoke prompts now. I'll annotate anything weird directly in this thread.

deploy-bot: Reminder: change window policy requires no new infra pushes between 23:00-01:00 UTC. Any emergency infra change must be approved by ops-lead and release-sherpa.

dennis: ACK. I'll be available for any quick hotfixes if needed.

release-sherpa: Final asks before 23:00: confirm docs link, release notes, and that on-call has run the rollback drill once this week. Also add temporary metric "prefix_cache_hit_ratio" to the canary dashboard for 30m post-rollout.

lucy: Release notes live: <https://redwood.internal/releases/3.5|3.5 release notes>. I called out observability changes and the migration notes.

ops-lead: On-call did a rapid rollback drill today at 10:00 UTC. Ready.

sam-qc: Smoke results will be posted T+5. I'll ping if anything looks off. :mag:

release-sherpa: Thanks all. If no objections, we start the freeze at 23:00 UTC and roll at 23:30. I'll post final GO/NO-GO at 23:05. :white_check_mark:
